{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Compute mean age including -1 values (as per literal population)
mean_age_with_neg1 = df['customer_age'].mean()

# Compute mean age excluding -1 values (as per valid interpretation)
valid_ages = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']
mean_age_excluding_neg1 = valid_ages.mean()

print(f'Mean age including -1: {mean_age_with_neg1}')
print(f'Mean age excluding -1: {mean_age_excluding_neg1}')"}
